subject: Customized Set of 12 Blue Pottery Dinner Bowls
message: Namaste Rameshwar-ji! I loved your peacock urn. Can your studio hand-paint a custom set of 12 dinner soup bowls with a deep turquoise rim and floral motif for our new home in Pune? Could you advise lead time and quotation?
artisanReply: Namaste Vikram-ji! Dhanyawad for appreciating our craft. Yes, our guild can hand-turn and paint 12 soup bowls. It will take approx 18-20 days for shaping, sun drying, raw glaze painting, and single firing. We would be delighted to craft this for your new home.

subject: Thank you for the Tree of Life painting!
message: Dear Shobha Devi-ji and the wonderful sisters in Jitwarpur: I received the Tree of Life canvas yesterday. The precision of the bamboo nib lines brought tears of joy to my grandmother's eyes. Thank you for keeping this sacred art alive!
